text:
maya: heads-up — CI run for quantized-1.2 showed ~12% sample drop in eval traces, looks like runner is dropping per-sample logs when the trace-ingest queue hits ~8k. Observed metric drift on rouge_l vs baseline. @kevin can you take a look? :eyes:

kevin: ack, attaching last runner logs. Noticed many 429s from trace-proxy and subsequent "sample-dropped" events.

kevin: ```
2026-03-19T14:12:03Z runner INFO upload trace evalid=E12345 status=retrying code=429
2026-03-19T14:12:03Z runner WARN sample-dropped evalid=E12346 reason=ingest_queue_full
2026-03-19T14:12:04Z runner INFO upload trace evalid=E12347 status=failed retries=3
```

eval-bot: FAIL: eval-runner/12456 trace-upload 429 rate limit exceeded (retry exhausted)

sam: is this the same issue as the GC spikes from last month? or backpressure on the proxy layer?

jules: likely different — last month was storage GC. this looks like ingress queue saturation + backoff behavior. we saw something similar when batch size + parallelism were high.

kevin: repro steps: run eval-runner with env OVERRIDE_PARALLELISM=16 and BATCH_SIZE=256; trace-proxy queue_usize goes >8000 and starts rejecting.

kevin: config snippet: ```
runner:
  parallelism: 16
  batch_size: 256
ingest:
  max_inflight: 8000
  retry_policy:
    max_retries: 3
    initial_backoff_ms: 200
```

maya: proposed quick fixes: reduce default parallelism in CI to 4, add client-side circuit breaker when queue>5000, and emit new metric "trace_coverage_pct" per run.

sam: +1 on trace_coverage_pct. wire it into dashboards and CI gates (fail if <98%). also add sample_drop counter with reason tags.

jules: infra suggestion: change proxy to return 503 when overloaded (so runner triggers exponential backoff) instead of 429. also increase S3 multipart concurrency for large artifacts to avoid long tails.

infra-bot: deploy queued: trace-proxy config bump (max_handlers=2048) — staged to canary us-west-2.

kevin: created PR with changes to default CI envs and a runner patch to emit coverage metric: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-runner/pull/872

maya: can we also ensure per-sample ids are preserved on drops? current behavior loses evalid mapping which breaks diffing and postmortems.

sam: runner should emit an audit-log line for any dropped sample: "dropped_sample:evalid=<id> reason=<reason>". add TTL to retry queue so very old samples don't hang around.

jules: will add dashboard panels: trace_coverage_pct, sample_drop_rate_by_reason, ingest_queue_depth. alert if sample_drop_rate > 0.1% over 5m.

maya: thanks — action items: kevin PR, infra canary, jules dashboard, sam runner audit log. i'll follow up in tomorrow sync. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: NOTE: scheduled CI run (quantized-1.2) requeued with parallelism=4 and batch_size=64; will report trace_coverage_pct after completion.
